research_question: What is the effect of galantamine 16–24 mg/day (regular release, 8–12 mg twice daily) compared with placebo on cognitive function, measured as ADAS-cog change from baseline at approximately 6 months, in people with Alzheimer's disease?
treatment_label: Galantamine 16–24 mg/day (regular release, 8–12 mg twice daily)
outcome_description: Cognitive function measured by the Alzheimer's Disease Assessment Scale – cognitive subscale (ADAS-cog), as change from baseline at approximately 6 months (range 3–6 month endpoint accepted). Lower ADAS-cog scores indicate better cognition; the pooled statistic is a Mean Difference (MD) on the common ADAS-cog metric. For multi-dose trials sharing one placebo group (e.g. Tariot 2000, Brodaty 2005), only the 16–24 mg/day regular-release arm is extracted against the shared placebo.
positive_direction: A positive effect size means galantamine 16–24 mg/day produced better cognitive outcomes than placebo (i.e. less deterioration / greater improvement on ADAS-cog, corresponding to a lower ADAS-cog change score).
search_queries: galantamine Alzheimer's disease randomized placebo-controlled trial ADAS-cog
galantamine 24 mg day cognition trial Alzheimer outcome
cholinesterase inhibitor galantamine placebo controlled dementia cognitive effect
inclusion_criteria: Participants with Alzheimer's disease (any severity) or probable Alzheimer's dementia
Study compares galantamine (regular release, around 16–24 mg/day) with a placebo control condition
Reports some quantitative cognitive outcome, preferably ADAS-cog change from baseline (means with SD/SE, CIs, or test statistics usable for an effect size)
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic review, meta-analysis, editorial, opinion piece, commentary, theoretical or narrative paper)
No comparison between a galantamine treatment condition and a placebo/control condition (e.g. open-label single-arm extensions, active-comparator-only designs)
No quantitative outcome data from which an effect size can be computed (no means+SDs/SEs, t/F values, proportions, or odds ratios)
Completely unrelated to galantamine treatment of Alzheimer's disease cognition (e.g. other drugs, other diseases, non-clinical/animal studies)
moderators_to_extract: Exact galantamine daily dose and titration schedule
Baseline disease severity (baseline MMSE or ADAS-cog)
Publication year and funding source (industry vs independent)
effect_size_note: Pool as Mean Difference on the ADAS-cog scale (all studies use the same instrument). Sign results so that a positive value favours galantamine; since lower ADAS-cog = better, the raw between-group difference (galantamine minus placebo) must be reversed in sign. For multi-arm trials with a shared placebo group, extract only the 16–24 mg/day regular-release arm; do not double-count the shared placebo across dose arms.
